verses.ar:
O Laal Meri Pat Rakhiyo Bala Jhoole Laalan
Sindri Da Sehvan Da Sakhi Shabaaz Qalandar
verses.en:
O red robed Lord, may I always be protected
O lord of Sindh and sire of Sehwan — O noble Shahbaz Qalandar

verses.ar:
Chaar Charaag Tere Baran Hamesha
Panjwa Baaran Aayi Bala Jhoole Laalan
verses.en:
O Lord, your shrine is always lighted with four lamps
And here I come to light a fifth lamp in your honor

verses.ar:
O Laal Meri Pat Rakhiyo Bala Jhoole Laalan
Sindri Da Sehvan Da Sakhi Shabaaz Qalandar
verses.en:
O red robed Lord, may I always be protected
O lord of Sindh and sire of Sehwan — O noble Shahbaz Qalandar

verses.ar:
Duma Dum Mast Qalandar, Duma Dum Mast Qalandar
Ali Dum Dum De Andar, Ali Dum Dum De Andar
verses.en:
My breath is for the jubilant saint
Our Master Ali's divinely breath in every breath of yours

verses.ar:
Uchra Roza Peera Tera, Uchra Roza Peera Tera
Gaith Wage Gharyaal Bala Jhoole Laalan
verses.en:
Oh my mentor, your shrine is high
Songs are played in sync with the clock — long live O Saint!

verses.ar:
Ghanan Ghanan Teri Nobat Waagay
Naal Vajay Gharyaal Bala Jhoole Laalan
verses.en:
O Lord, may your illustrious name ring out in Hind and Sindh
May the bells ring out your good glory day and night
